Definition: from a compound of G5140 and G2094; a three years' period (triennium):--space of three years.
BiblicalUsage: Paul tells the Ephesian elders to remember his three years among them, warning every one night and day with tears. He tells the elders to remember that by the space of three years he ceased not to warn every one night and day with tears.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe three years measures a shepherd: night and day, with tears, and not one person unwarned.
